## Policies

### Peer Review

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Type** | Double-anonymized — APA's official term is "masked review"; author name/affiliation appear only on a separate title page, not in the manuscript body (verified via apa.org/pubs/journals/ocp/submit, 2026-07-20). |
| **Transferable / Cascade?** | *(pending — APA has cross-journal transfer for some titles)* |
| **Reviewer reports published?** | No (per APA default) |
| **Typical R+R rounds** | *(pending — typically 1-2 rounds)* |
| **Reviewer recommendations** | *(pending)* |
### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | No (follows APA publisher default) |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | No — disclosure-based |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 4 |
| **Summary** | Follows APA publisher AI policy (generic across APA journals, not JOHP-specific): authors must disclose use of generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) in the Methods section and cite the tool/prompt used. AI cannot satisfy authorship criteria; authors remain fully responsible for the accuracy of any AI-assisted content. Authors must NOT enter confidential material (e.g., research data or participant/client notes that could identify a participant) into open generative AI tools. No pre-approval required — disclosure-based only. Leniency score (4) is the original maintainer judgment call; an independent AI research pass scored the same facts as 3/5 — flagged here as a scale-calibration disagreement, not a factual one, pending a defined scoring rubric. |
| **Source URL** | https://www.apa.org/pubs/journals/resources/publishing-tips/policy-generative-ai (verified 2026-07-20; generic policy also linked from https://www.apa.org/pubs/journals/policies/) |

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — workplace diversity × health |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Occupational health psychology — work stress, burnout, work-family conflict, workplace safety, recovery from work, job demands-resources |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **workplace + health/wellbeing intersection**. SOHP affiliated.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure I/O redirected to J Applied Psych / Personnel Psych; pure health redirected to Health Psychology.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Manuscripts without workplace + health intersection
- AI use without disclosure per APA policy
- Pure correlational without theoretical contribution

### Soft Tax

Low for OHP tradition authors. Diary / ESM designs are distinctive editorial strength.

### Best Suited For

- Work stress and burnout research
- Work-family conflict studies
- Recovery from work research
- Workplace safety empirical work
- Workplace mental health interventions
- JD-R model empirical tests
- Experience sampling / diary studies at work

### Not Recommended For

- Pure I/O selection / performance (consider Personnel Psych)
- Pure clinical psychology (consider JCCP)
- Pure health psychology without workplace (consider Health Psychology)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Health Psychology](./health-psychology.md) | If health dominates over workplace; APA family |
| 2 | [Journal of Applied Psychology](./journal-of-applied-psychology.md) | If broader I/O angle; APA flagship |
| 3 | [Personnel Psychology](./personnel-psychology.md) | If I/O selection / performance angle; Wiley |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JCCP as "more workplace than clinical," JOHP is the natural APA SOHP home for occupational health.
